guest_architects.configuration.title: Guest Architects
guest_architects.configuration.min_popul: Smallest base population of a living city.
guest_architects.configuration.max_popul: Largest base population of a living city.
guest_architects.configuration.fluctuati: Length of a fluctuating city's population cycle, in Guest years.
Relative amplitude of a fluctuating city's population cycle.
guest_architects.configuration.decline_y: Years a declining city needs to fall from full population to zero.
guest_architects.configuration.abandoned: Whether sculk keeps spreading through abandoned and extinct cities over time.
guest_architects.configuration.spread_ma: Maximum spread radius around each sculk site of an abandoned city.
guest_architects.configuration.spread_da: Days after abandonment for sculk to reach about 63% of its maximum radius.
guest_architects.configuration.max_assis: Maximum total delay player help can add to a city's decline.
guest_architects.configuration.notice_th: Interference points at which Architects stop and watch the player (a hit is 2 points, broken wool or a candle or a shriek 1; breaking sculk, the reinforced deepslate frame or the memory place raises the score to the equipment threshold at once).
guest_architects.configuration.immobiliz: Interference points at which the player is lifted and held in the air.
guest_architects.configuration.equipment: Interference points at which, while the player is held, armor, the main weapon and a tool are taken one by one.
guest_architects.configuration.removal_t: Interference points at which the player is pushed through a removal portal.
guest_architects.configuration.destroy_e: Whether taken items burn away in the air; otherwise they drop at the player's feet.
guest_architects.configuration.portal_re: Whether Architects remove persistent intruders through a portal.
guest_architects.configuration.interfere: Interference points forgotten per day; faster for players who helped.
guest_architects.configuration.piglin_zo: Seconds of Overworld exposure before piglins and hoglins turn (vanilla: 15).
guest_architects.configuration.architect: Chance that a naturally spawned zombie keeps old Architect armor.
guest_architects.command.no_city: No ancient city is known in this dimension yet.
guest_architects.command.info: City %s: %s, %s, base %s, population now %s, help delay %s days, empty since day %s, sculk radius %s, ritual rooms %s, memory place %s, ruin pieces %s / %s, recognition %s, damage %s, known players %s
guest_architects.command.updated: City %s updated; it will re-materialize while observed.
guest_architects.configuration.silence_r: Blocks around an Architect in which a player's vibrations and scent go unnoticed by sculk and Wardens (0 disables).
guest_architects.configuration.nether_re: Chance that a removal portal leads to the Nether instead of the surface.
guest_architects.configuration.cure_infe: Whether zombified piglins, zoglins, zombie horses and zombie nautiluses can be cured like zombie villagers (Weakness + golden apple).
guest_architects.command.not_living: Nobody ever lived in this city; only a living city can die out.
guest_architects.command.no_witness: No Architect of a living city is near enough to witness it.
guest_architects.configuration.city.tool: Living cities and their slow life.
The virus and its infected forms.
